/gorilla-trekking.title: Gorilla Trekking Rwanda
/gorilla-trekking.heading: Gorilla Trekking in Volcanoes National Park
/gorilla-trekking.description: Book gorilla trekking in Rwanda with permits, lodges, and licensed guides in Volcanoes National Park near Musanze.
paragraphs: Mountain gorilla trekking in Volcanoes National Park is Rwanda's signature wildlife experience. Trek misty bamboo forest with a licensed guide and spend a protected hour with a gorilla family.
RwandaQuest arranges gorilla permits, 4x4 transfers from Kigali, and lodging in Musanze. Most travelers spend 2–3 nights so the trek is not rushed.
Golden monkey tracking and a visit to the Dian Fossey grave can be added to the same itinerary.
/gorilla-trekking.imageAlt: Mountain gorillas in Volcanoes National Park, Rwanda

/akagera-safari.title: Akagera Safari
/akagera-safari.heading: Akagera National Park Safari
/akagera-safari.description: Book an Akagera safari in Rwanda — Big Five game drives, Lake Ihema boat cruises, and overnight lodges with local guides.
paragraphs: Akagera National Park is Rwanda's Big Five savannah. Game drives can reveal lions, elephants, rhinos, buffalo, and leopards across lakes and open plains.
A boat safari on Lake Ihema is the best way to see hippos, crocodiles, and waterbirds. Most visitors stay 2–3 days.
We provide park fees, a safari 4x4 with a driver-guide, and lodge or tented-camp bookings.
/akagera-safari.imageAlt: Wildlife safari in Akagera National Park, Rwanda

/nyungwe-forest.title: Nyungwe Forest
/nyungwe-forest.heading: Nyungwe Forest Canopy & Chimpanzees
/nyungwe-forest.description: Walk Africa's longest canopy bridge and track chimpanzees in Nyungwe Forest with RwandaQuest local guides.
paragraphs: Nyungwe is an ancient montane rainforest with chimpanzees, 13 primate species, waterfalls, and a 160-metre canopy walkway.
Chimpanzee tracking starts early. Combine it with the canopy walk and a night near the park for a complete rainforest stay.
/nyungwe-forest.imageAlt: Nyungwe Forest canopy walkway in Rwanda

/lake-kivu.title: Lake Kivu Tours
/lake-kivu.heading: Lake Kivu Lakeside Tours
/lake-kivu.description: Relax on Lake Kivu with boat trips, coffee visits, and lakeside lodges between gorilla trekking and Nyungwe Forest.
paragraphs: Lake Kivu is Rwanda's largest lake — a calm stop between Volcanoes National Park and Nyungwe. Swim, take a boat to the islands, and visit coffee farms.
Rubavu (Gisenyi) and Karongi are the main bases. Two to three nights works well in a Rwanda circuit.
/lake-kivu.imageAlt: Lake Kivu shoreline in western Rwanda

/kigali-tours.title: Kigali City Tours
/kigali-tours.heading: Kigali City Tours
/kigali-tours.description: Book a Kigali city tour — Genocide Memorial, local markets, Inema Arts Center, and airport transfers with a local guide.
paragraphs: Kigali is one of Africa's cleanest capitals and the usual start or end of a Rwanda trip. A guided city tour covers the Kigali Genocide Memorial, craft markets, and contemporary art.
We also run airport pickups and one-night stopovers before gorilla trekking or safari departures.
